record.paper_title: Some Open Problems in Polyomino Tilings
record.context_brief: Whether all rep-tile polyominoes tile rectangles
record.original_question: A rep-tile polyomino is a polyomino that tiles a scaled copy of itself. Does every rep-tile polyomino also tile some rectangle?

evidence.quote: The deeply studied notion of substitution tilings [12,20] also gives rise to consideration of polyominoes that tiles scaled versions of themselves, called rep-tiles.
Many rep-tile polyominoes are known ... all of which also tile rectangles. Hochberg and Reid [24] asked whether this is true of all rep-tiles
Open Problem 13 (Asked in [24]) Does every rep-tile polyomino tile some rectangle?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
A polyomino is a finite, edge-connected union of unit squares in the integer lattice $\mathbb{Z}^2$. A polyomino $P$ is called a rep-tile if, for some integer $k \geq 2$, the region obtained by scaling $P$ by a factor of $k$ can be tiled by congruent copies of $P$ (allowing translations, rotations, and reflections). A polyomino $P$ is said to tile a rectangle if some axis-aligned rectangle in $\mathbb{Z}^2$ can be tiled by congruent copies of $P$.

Question: Does every rep-tile polyomino tile some rectangle?
artifact.status_search_result: The question, attributed to Hochberg and Reid, appears still open in two dimensions: all known rep-tile polyominoes also tile a rectangle, but no proof or counterexample is known. Hochberg and Reid did construct an "unboxable" rep-tile in three dimensions (a polycube that tiles a larger copy of itself but no rectangular box), but the 2D polyomino question remains unsolved.

status_evidence.title: The Geometry Junkyard: Polyominoes
status_evidence.snippet: Robert Hochberg and Michael Reid exhibit an unboxable reptile: a polycube that can tile a larger copy of itself, but can't tile any rectangular block.
status_evidence.claim: Hochberg and Reid constructed an unboxable rep-tile polycube in 3D, motivating the open 2D question.

status_evidence.title: Some Open Problems in Polyomino Tilings
status_evidence.snippet: Open Problem 13: Does every rep-tile polyomino tile some rectangle?
status_evidence.claim: Listed as an open problem in a survey of polyomino tilings.
